selection_scope: seen activity semantic prototypes only; one equally weighted row per seen activity; no sensor samples, fitted classifier, unseen prototype, or test metric
method: directional normalized conditional-entropy reduction + exact subset DP
zero_entropy_target_policy: D[i,j]=0 when H(A_j)=0 because the target has no uncertainty to reduce
tie_breaking: lexicographically earliest order in the split A2 schema
reverse_definition: exact reversal of the optimal forward order
